paths.description: Live-score homepage, the primary real-time score task and shared site chrome.
Champions League detail/schedule, representing league database pages.
Account login, representing the authentication and form journey.
Prominent advertising destination, tested to verify where score-page banners lead.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot is pixel-identical to the light screenshot; white score rows and pale chrome remain unchanged.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface, text, border, and image treatments.

findings.summary: The loading animation continues under reduced-motion.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe reports matchMedia reduce=true while the timeMin animation remains running with an infinite iteration count; no reduced-motion CSS was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential looping motion in a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce query.

findings.summary: Navigation is wired as abrupt JavaScript state changes rather than resilient, transition-aware navigation.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found 53 javascript: links and zero View Transition CSS; homepage navigation and score tabs are custom onclick state changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real links/buttons and progressively enhance meaningful state or route changes with View Transitions while respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Advertising repeatedly interrupts the score list and dominates the content hierarchy.
findings.evidence: The 360px homepage and results screenshots show full-width gambling banners inserted between small score rows, plus a dismissible domain banner above the primary UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove in-feed interruption ads from the primary score journey or confine clearly labelled advertising to non-obscuring, dismissible placements.

findings.summary: The complex score UI uses viewport-era physical CSS rather than component responsiveness.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found 0 container-query rules and 479 physical left/right declarations; reused score rows and navigation are presented at materially different widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Make reused score and navigation components size-aware with container queries and intrinsic/logical sizing.

findings.summary: Several primary controls lack visible focus and adequate target treatment.
findings.evidence: The focus probe reports outline none on active score filters, while Lighthouse fails target-size and the mobile screenshot shows densely packed controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic controls, preserve a strong :focus-visible indicator, and provide at least 24px spaced targets, preferably 44px for primary touch actions.

findings.summary: The primary score page is very slow and blocks interaction.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 13.0s and TBT 3,890ms (performance 0.30); the CDP trace corroborates LCP 5.39s and 1,968ms total blocking time.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the score-page LCP, defer non-critical work, and split long tasks until LCP and interaction responsiveness reach good thresholds.

findings.summary: The load ships render-blocking resources and duplicated heavy analytics code.
findings.evidence: The HAR records 99 requests/2.63MB, 25 scripts/1.80MB, 10 grounded render-blocking candidates and 51 third-party requests; Lighthouse estimates 712KiB unused JS and 70KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate tags, defer non-critical scripts, shorten blocking chains, cache static assets, and ship only route-critical code.

findings.summary: The page lacks accessible names and alternatives at scale.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 43 images without alt and 42 links without discernible names; the images primitive independently reports 44 missing alt attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful images alternatives, mark decoration empty-alt, and replace empty/custom links with named semantic buttons or links.

findings.summary: The document has no heading or landmark structure and focus is inconsistently suppressed.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero headings and zero main/nav/header/footer landmarks; Lighthouse fails main-landmark and the focus probe shows outline:none on multiple controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a logical heading hierarchy and semantic landmarks, then make DOM/tab order and visible focus follow reading order.

findings.summary: The viewport explicitly prevents user zoom and some targets are too small.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence contains maximum-scale=1.0,user-scalable=0; Lighthouse fails meta-viewport and target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale/user-scalable restrictions and enlarge or space touch targets.

findings.summary: Some text and controls fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports two foreground/background contrast failures; dense pale metadata is visible in the mobile score screenshots.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust text and essential-control tokens to meet WCAG contrast ratios in all states.

findings.summary: Dense score rows compromise reading comfort.
findings.evidence: The 360px screenshots pack multiple teams, times and odds into narrow 28–40px rows with very small pale metadata and interleaved banners.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase text size/line height and grouping, and reduce competing information so teams, state, and odds scan clearly.

findings.summary: Image and document asset hygiene is weak.
findings.evidence: The images primitive reports 58 images without dimensions, 56 oversized and 77 legacy-format images; Lighthouse corroborates 52 unsized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions and responsive sources, preserve aspect ratio, and convert eligible assets to efficient formats.

findings.summary: The page triggers deprecated API, BFCache and inspector issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports two deprecated-API warnings, one BFCache failure reason and one DevTools inspector issue.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated APIs and the recorded BFCache/inspector blockers, then verify in current DevTools.

findings.summary: Primary navigation and score actions are not crawlable.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found 53 javascript: links; Lighthouse fails crawlable-anchors with 10 representative failures and flags robots.txt validity.
findings.suggestedFix: Use descriptive real href URLs for routes and valid buttons for in-page actions; correct unsupported robots patterns.

findings.summary: The robots policy contains an invalid pattern despite otherwise useful sitemap/canonical signals.
findings.evidence: Manual fetch returned a sitemap index and canonical URL, but Lighthouse marks robots.txt invalid; robots.txt contains the nonstandard pattern Disallow: *-{$mid}.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace nonstandard robots directives with valid crawler syntax and verify each sitemap child remains reachable.

findings.summary: Essential security headers and cookie protections are absent.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy; all 14 observed cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP and HSTS, add nosniff/frame/referrer/permissions policies, and set cookies Secure with an appropriate SameSite mode.

findings.summary: The page loads an excessive tracking and third-party footprint.
findings.evidence: Trackers found 11 third-party origins and four known trackers; HAR attributes 51 requests and 2.25MB to third parties, including about 1.60MB from Google Tag Manager.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate analytics to one justified, consent-aware setup; remove duplicate trackers and defer/minimise remaining collection.

findings.summary: Authentication is password/social-provider only, with no phishing-resistant option.
findings.evidence: The login screenshot and DOM show email/password plus Google/Facebook login; no WebAuthn/passkey affordance is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and authentication alongside recovery-capable fallback methods.

findings.summary: Live-score content is not available without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 52% raw/rendered word overlap; the crawler screenshot shows a permanent “loading data” card while the rendered screenshot contains scores.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the primary score list and real navigation, then hydrate live updates as a progressive enhancement.

findings.summary: The stylesheet is not prepared for alternate writing directions.
findings.evidence: The document correctly declares lang=th, but the CSS probe found 0 logical-property uses and 479 physical left/right declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Retain the correct language declaration and migrate directional layout to logical properties, with dir-aware testing.

findings.summary: Unlabelled score-page ads lead to gambling promotion and unrelated QR acquisition.
findings.evidence: Prominent in-feed banners have empty accessible text; following /ad/1729.html redirects to a LINE add-friend QR page, while banners visibly promote betting/casino products.
findings.suggestedFix: Clearly label sponsorship and destinations, remove disguised gambling/QR redirects from the core score flow, and expose honest destination text.

findings.summary: The login form gives no visible feedback after an empty submission.
findings.evidence: The before and post-submit login screenshots are identical; no required-field guidance or actionable error appears.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after submit/interaction, mark fields invalid, announce a concise error, and move focus to an error summary or first invalid field.

findings.summary: Login fields use invalid autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: Login DOM uses autocomplete="account" and autocomplete="pwd" instead of username and current-password.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete="username" and autocomplete="current-password" so password managers and autofill work reliably.

findings.summary: The page transfers many unoptimised and eagerly loaded images.
findings.evidence: Images evidence reports 56 oversized, 55 below-fold images without lazy loading, 77 legacy-format images and 58 without dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Right-size responsive images, prefer AVIF/WebP, lazy-load below-fold media, and reserve intrinsic space.

findings.summary: Duplicated background analytics performs disproportionate work.
findings.evidence: HAR shows 10 separate Google tag/gtag payloads among 25 scripts; the trace records six long tasks and 1,968ms blocking time.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate analytics containers, batch justified telemetry, and defer background work until it cannot contend with the score task.

findings.summary: The initial memory footprint is high for a score listing.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 706,318 nodes and 43.3MB self size; after repeated tab switching it contains 750,269 nodes and 44.3MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile dominant native/code/array allocations, virtualise long score lists where appropriate, and remove duplicated script state.

taskList.title: Make the live-score path fast and progressively rendered
Remove disguised gambling/QR advertising from the core journey
Deploy security headers, safe cookie attributes, and privacy-minimised analytics
Rebuild navigation and score controls with semantic, crawlable, accessible elements
Restore zoom, contrast, legibility, and touch target quality
Add preference-driven dark and reduced-motion modes
Improve login validation, autofill, and passkey support
Profile and reduce the large initial heap footprint
